`module.github_app_runner_group:data.aws_secretsmanager_secret.secrets` looks up secret metadata by name, but the underlying secrets are created in the same configuration by `:resource.aws_secretsmanager_secret.cicd_secrets` (forge_runners/secrets.tf). No reference or depends_on links them, so on a fresh apply this data source can be read before the secret exists and fail. Add depends_on (on the module call or data source) to the secret resource.

`module.github_global_lock:data.aws_secretsmanager_secret.secrets` looks up secret metadata by name, but those secrets are provisioned by `:resource.aws_secretsmanager_secret.cicd_secrets` in the parent module. With no dependency edge, this read can occur before the secret is created on a fresh apply. Add depends_on to the secret resource.

`module.github_actions_job_logs:data.aws_secretsmanager_secret.secrets` looks up secret metadata by name, but the secrets are created by `:resource.aws_secretsmanager_secret.cicd_secrets` in the parent module.
